messages:
maya: Quick checkpoint for LedgersEdge week0. Main open items: audit-log forwarding to their Splunk, KMS cross-account access decision (policy vs grant), and a note that renewal conversation might start earlier if they ramp quickly. Can infra/security pair for the next 24h?

ravi-ledgers: Hi all 1: Splunk team needs a sample event shape so they can map fields. Our network team also flagged that firewall is dropping outbound to splunk-collector:6514. I verified from an instance: tcpdump shows TLS handshake starts then connection reset.

chris-sre: @ravi-ledgers can you paste the tcpdump snippet and the security group/NGFW policy IDs? Also confirm if syslog agent is using TLS mutual auth.

ravi-ledgers: tcpdump: 
15:12:01.123 IP 10.11.12.13.51820 > 10.20.30.99.6514: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460], length 0
15:12:01.456 IP 10.20.30.99.6514 > 10.11.12.13.51820: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0, length 0
SG: sg-0b2c3d4e; NGFW policy id fw-ldg-3
Agent: rsyslog over TCP/TLS, no mTLS.

anika: For KMS: Ravi, what's your desired key usage? If you want Redwood to encrypt at rest and we never hold plaintext, a grant is simplest (no key policy edits). If you want us to manage rotation, adding our role to key policy + enabling re-encrypt is cleaner.

ravi-ledgers: We prefer minimum perms, so grant sounds fine. Security wants to see CLI example and proof of revoke flow before they approve.

anika: Grant example (CLI):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 \\\\--grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-inference-priv-role \\\\--operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey DescribeKey\\n```
Revoke: `aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <id>` or delete the grant principal from policy if created that way.

devon: On Splunk egress: the NGFW is probably blocking return packets for established connections because of expectation of TLS profile. Short term: allow outbound to 10.20.30.99:6514 on fw-ldg-3 and add stateful allow for the ephemeral ports. Long term: we should run a connectivity test from our collectors (I can spawn one in your account using the runbook).

ops-bot: runbook: start-collector-check job queued by devon at 2026-04-02T15:20:00Z. Job ID job-6791.

chris-sre: Action: Ravi -> share Splunk sample schema (a small JSON event) and open a temporary egress rule for 10.20.30.99:6514. Anika -> send grant example + revoke steps. Devon -> schedule collector run (will use job-6791). Maya -> capture feedback request for playbook: customers commonly ask for a prefilled Splunk mapping and a checklist for syslog agent TLS settings.

ravi-ledgers: Uploaded sample event to the channel: `{ "ts": "2026-04-02T15:10:00Z", "level": "info", "service": "redwood-client", "msg": "inference request processed", "req_id": "r-123" }`

ops-bot: job-6791 started at 2026-04-02T15:21:10Z 1: collector check returned: CONNECT OK from collector-runner-12 -> 10.20.30.99:6514 (TLS handshake ok). Logs: https://internal.redwood/runs/job-6791

ravi-ledgers: Hmm our firewall team says they still see resets in prod path; dev instance did work. Difference might be an intermediate NGFW cluster. I'll route a pcap.

anika: Regarding KMS revoke proof: we can run an exercise where we create a short-lived grant and demonstrate retire-grant step; I'll coordinate with you on a time. Also note: if you ever enable EncryptionContext restrictions, revoke semantics change (need careful testing).

maya: Renewal signal: Simon, FYI customer mentioned Dedicated interest if cost/p95 latency stable and they exceed ~200M tokens/month. Mark as early-opportunity (engagement required).

simon-sales: Got it. I'll request projected monthly token usage from Ravi and propose a 30/60/90 day trial package. Ravi, can you share current QPS and expected ramp?

ravi-ledgers: Current is tiny (0.6 QPS) but expected to be ~8 QPS in 3 months as we onboard services. I'll DM Simon with a simple table.

chris-sre: Once Splunk path is green and KMS grant applied, we can close week0. Please update runbook with the exact NGFW rule IDs and grant command used so future customers can copy.

maya: Feedback capture: add two artifacts to our onboarding kit: (1) Splunk mapping template (2) KMS grant vs policy decision matrix + revoke demo steps. I'll draft and share by EOD.

ravi-ledgers: KMS grant created in test: grant-id g-77a8. I'll hand over production request after security ok.

ops-bot: runbook: mark-step completed: splunk-collector-test (job-6791) at 2026-04-02T15:28:30Z.

anika: I'll schedule a 30-min revoke demo tomorrow 10:30 PT. Ravi, please confirm availability.

ravi-ledgers: Confirmed 10:30 PT works. Thanks team! :rocket:
